tips: 1- Linked default account number is customer’s main default account at Capital bank. Can be changed to any eligible accounts available.
2- Alias must be minimum of 3 characters, maximum of 10 with at least 1 letter and can be alphanumeric.
3- Disclaimer to inform customers that their own personal information’s (name, IBAN) will be shared with issuer of CliQ transaction.
4- Suspended id will not be able to receive any CliQ transactions.
5- Only 5 Aliases ( Nickname/ Mobile number) are allowed per customer.
6- If Alias was suspended for more than 3 months It will be deleted.
7- Alias must not be a commercial name.
